events.title: Lake Harriet Buckthorn Slaying
events.description:
Help clear buckthorn around Lake Harriet!

Dates: Tuesdays and Thursdays 9-11am, May-September

Location: West side of Lake Harriet, between West 42nd and West 44th

Supplies: Bring your own water bottle, safety glasses, work gloves, and wear a long sleeve shirt and long pants. We will supply training and tools. If you prefer to bring your own tools (loppers, hand saws, and pruners are permitted) please mark them with your name.

Host: Lake Harriet Environmental Committee

Email Jim Nicholas to get involved jnicholas5329@gmail.com

events.title: Knitting in Nature
events.description:
First and third Thursday of September and October from 4 – 5:30 pm.

Bring your projects and join fellow crafters in the garden for knitting, crocheting, and crafting in community as Autumn settles in the Garden.

All experience levels are welcome!

Some chairs provided. No registration necessary, meet at the Visitor Shelter.

events.title: Rose Garden Volunteering
events.description:
Calling all rose lovers! Join the Deadheaders and develop skills while supporting care of the historic rose garden. Each gardening day will focus on a different topic related to the seasonal maintenance of Lyndale Park Rose Garden.

Dates: 1st and 3rd Saturday & select Thursdays, May-October, 9-11am

Location: Lyndale Park Rose Garden
Meet near the Heffelfinger fountain

Supplies: Gloves, tools and parking passes will be provided

Weather: We work in light rain but will suspend or cancel work in severe weather

NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY – ALL ARE WELCOME!

Sign-up here

events.title: Early Birders – October
events.description:
Saturdays in October 9:30-11:30am

Learn to observe and identify birds by sound and sight as you walk through the Garden and Wirth Park with a Garden Naturalist.

No registration necessary, meet at the Garden’s parking lot.

events.title: Minnehaha Park Invasive Plant Management
events.description:
Join us for buckthorn removal (and other restoration activities) in Minnehaha Regional Park!

Dates: Saturdays 10-noon, through October

Location: Meet at 4749 46th Ave S, parking lot. Wabun Park Maintenance Facility.

Supplies: Tools and instruction provided. Bring a water bottle, gloves, close-toed shoes, long pants, and clothes that can get dirty.

Host: Friends of Minnehaha Park

Learn more here.

Updates will be posted to Facebook.

events.title: Minnehaha Regional Park Buckthorn Removal
events.description:
Dates: Every Sunday 10-noon, July 12th-October 25th

Location: Minnehaha Regional Park. Sign up below. A link to the exact location will be included in your confirmation email.

Supplies: Please bring loppers and work gloves if you have them. Bring water and wear long clothing.

Host: Buckthorn Removal Singles Club

Learn more here

events.title: Brush with Nature
events.description:
Brush with Nature

Sunday, October 11 and 18 from 1-3:30 pm.

Gather in community and get creative with watercolors inspired by the autumn colors

around you! Naturalist-led instruction and introduction to watercolors offered on the hour. Take to the trails and get creative. All skill levels welcome! Some basic materials provided. Gather outside the Visitor Shelter.

October 18th: Meet Presley Martin, a local artist, amateur mycologist, and Minnesota water steward, who creates art with objects found while exploring area forests and the Mississippi River. Presley will demonstrate his unique “mushroom markers”, and visitors can experience more of his work at the American Swedish Institute through October 25.

events.title: Peace Garden Volunteering
events.description:
Join the Peacekeepers for staff-led volunteering in the Peace Garden! This fun and friendly group meets twice a week to care for this beloved garden. Activities include planting, weeding, light pruning, and general garden maintenance.

Dates: Mondays and Wednesdays, 9:30-11:30am through October.

Location: Lyndale Park Peace Garden. Meet your host Jacob in the parking lot.

Supplies: Gloves, tools and parking passes will be provided.

Weather: We work in light rain but will suspend or cancel work in severe weather.

Sign-up here

events.title: Help out in the JD Rivers’ Children’s Garden!
events.description:
Help out in the JD Rivers’ Children’s Garden!

Tasks will vary depending on the time of year, but may include: weeding, planting, watering, garden clean-up, soil transportation and more.

Dates: Spring and Fall dates, morning and evening times

Location: JD Rivers’ Children’s Garden. 2900 Glenwood Ave, Minneapolis, MN. 55405

Parking: Parking is available on the south side of Glenwood Ave and perpendicular streets

Supplies: Gloves and tools will be provided

Weather: We work in light rain but will suspend or cancel work in severe weather

NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY – ALL ARE WELCOME!

Children are welcome, but must be accompanied by an adult. You will be asked to sign a volunteer waiver upon arrival.

Sign-up here

events.title: Habitat Restoration in Theo Wirth
events.description:
Join us to remove invasive species, including buckthorn, in Theodore Wirth Park! Volunteer activities include cutting, pulling, and hauling buckthorn and other invasive species. No experience is necessary. All instructions and equipment will be provided.

Dates: First and third Tuesdays of each month, May through October, 5:30-7:00

Location: Meet in front of the Trailhead

Supplies: Please bring your own work gloves if you have them, long sleeves, close-toed shoes, and a water bottle.

Host: This event is hosted by the Loppet

Learn more and sign-up
